title: Review output
description: The answer of a reviewer of a plan, an issue breakdown, a design artifact or a diff (ADR-ORG-004, section 1). Independent of the reviewer tool. The verdict is 'block' if and only if blocking_findings is non-empty. A finding is blocking only if it affects correctness, a stated requirement or a recorded decision (ADR-ORG-004, section 2); any other finding is non-blocking.

verdict.description: 'block' if and only if blocking_findings is non-empty, 'approve' otherwise.

summary.description: What was reviewed and the overall assessment, in a few sentences.

detail.description: What is wrong and why, with the evidence the reviewer read.

location.description: Where the defect is: 'path:line', 'path section', or a plan step. Null when the finding concerns the whole artifact.

basis.description: The requirement, decision or convention the finding is tied to.

reference.description: Its identifier, for example an issue's 'Done when' item, an ADR and section, or a convention file and section.
